subject: encode-cpu: scope + intent (no edits yet)
body: New Claude agent 'encode-cpu-opus' (CPU encode cost). Host-only, no device. Owns CPU hot paths in compute_frontend.m, render_pipeline.inc, compositor_submit.inc and NON-batching parts of render_encoder.inc. I see the render lead's uncommitted TEGU_PERF_ENCODE timers, lazy clears, module digest (TGRGV2 key) and C6F_ENCODE200 in ca_backboardd_host_test.py; I will build on them, not duplicate.
